# uptimekuma_notification_smsir (Resource)

SMS.ir notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_smsir" "example" {
  name       = "SMS.ir Notifications"
  api_key    = "your-smsir-api-key"
  number     = "09123456789"
  template   = "123456"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_smsir" "multiple_recipients" {
  name       = "SMS.ir Alerts"
  api_key    = "your-smsir-api-key"
  number     = "09123456789,09987654321"
  template   = "123456"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: api_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change api_key_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_smsir" "write_only" {
  name = "SMS.ir with a write-only secret"

  number   = "09123456789"
  template = "123456"

  api_key_wo         = "your-smsir-api-key"
  api_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `number` (String) The recipient phone number(s). Multiple numbers can be specified as a comma-separated list.
- `template` (String) The pre-approved SMS.ir template ID used for sending the message.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The SMS.ir API key used to send notifications. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SMS.ir API key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
